structure: A 60-line ruling file, workareas/shared/design-release-2-1/sources/ruling-ian-2026-11-25b.md, from Ian on 25 November 2026 (his second that day). It answers the two notification view header questions the 25 November re-distil raised from ruling:sam-2026-11-19 point 2. An intro (lines 1-5), then two sections: '## c-438: Amend becomes a link' (lines 7-27: a verbatim answer quote, the ruling in bold, and four 'why' bullets covering today's posting header, the POST that only renders a page, Delete's href pattern and why point 2 is unweakened) and '## c-447: plants gets Copy as new' (lines 29-60: a verbatim answer quote, the ruling in bold, four bullets naming the plants backend, persistence and engine code already on main, the missing header copyAction, the repo and increment consequences for inc-123 and inc-124, and an orchestrator's note on reading the carried-over against cleared split against plants' own fields). Scope is the whole file; nothing is left out.

parts.title: Whole ruling
parts.scope: The whole file, lines 1 to 60: the intro, the c-438 section and the c-447 section, including the orchestrator's note.
covers: c-438: once the amend confirmation page (inc-120) exists, 'Amend this notification' on the notification view header is a link to that page, not a posting button
c-438: Copy as new keeps its own form, Delete stays a link, and no action shares another action's form, in live animals, germinal products and plants alike

c-438 reasons: today's view-header.js gives amendAction and copyAction a postAction and deleteButtonFor an href; today's POST takes the record to AMEND and writes snapshots, so with a confirmation page the state change moves to the confirm button; a POST that only renders a page is the wrong verb and leaves a re-POST on the back button without JavaScript; Delete already opens its confirmation page by href
c-438: ruling:sam-2026-11-19 point 2 is not weakened, since a link shares no form, and point 2 still governs Copy as new
c-447: the high-risk plants notification view header gains a Copy as new action so both journeys offer the same three actions, answered deliberately against the default

c-447: wiring not a feature build; the plants backend NotificationController POST /{referenceNumber}/copy with NotificationCopyMapper and a 400 for a non-copyable status, the real and stub persistence create.js copy, and engine journey.js copyJourney are already on main
c-447: only the plants view-header.js copyAction and its route are missing (it builds actions { amend, delete })

c-447 consequences: trade-imports-plants-backend needs nothing and does not join the programme's repos; inc-123 takes plantsfrontend alongside backend, frontend and tests; inc-124's stale-copy return takes plants too

Orchestrator's note: the plants copy carries plants' own answers, so the carried-over trade against cleared shipment split (req-1425 and the rest of inc-123's criteria) is read against plants' own fields; where plants has no equivalent field there is nothing to carry or clear (an orchestrator reading, not Ian's words)
